Demonstrates strong full-stack engineering skills with a proven track record of architecting and shipping polished, user-facing products.
Approaches engineering with a product-driven mindset, exhibiting a strong eye for design, user experience, and performance optimization.
Embraces a high-ownership mentality, driving every feature through to completion and holding oneself to a high standard of quality.
Is naturally curious and ambitious, with a passion for tackling complex engineering challenges and translating them into seamless user experiences.
Has a strong bias for action, iterating and shipping features quickly even in environments with ambiguous specifications.

Is fully "AI-native," leveraging AI coding tools to amplify personal velocity and impact. This individual is eager to work in an environment where AI is a core pillar of both the product and internal operations, even if their current company does not fully embrace it.
Build, iterate, and scale web features using a modern stack including React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
Design and implement the backend services, APIs, and data pipelines that form the foundation of the platform and its AI capabilities.
An interest in franchising and the local business landscape is a plus.
